findings.text: follow-on: the module and _size_table docstrings (reckon/crew/run_time_profile.py:18, :279) claim a size bucket's `runs` is `the same quantity the group table reports`, but the equality holds only for rows the size classifier can bucket. A row carrying neither a parsed time_budget nor output_tokens resolves to (None, None) in _size_class (reckon/crew/run_time_profile.py:170) and is dropped from size_buckets, and a row with no agent/backend is likewise skipped, while both still count in the group table's `runs`; the two totals can therefore differ. Not reachable in the current data: an independent read of the live 14-day window returns rows 2101, group_runs 2101, bucket_runs 2101 (every row classifies and every row carries a wall time), so the claim is exact for the observed population and only over-reaches for a shape not yet seen. Documentation precision, not a functional defect in this node's change.
